results.title: The Way It Goes
results.overview: Nilay, who rarely comes together with her family, travels by car with her brother Caner and her aunt Songül to their village in the steppe to bury their father. The hearse carrying their father’s body follows them on the road. During the journey, an unexpected event forces Nilay and Caner to face moments they have long avoided.

results.title: The Deranged Drummer
results.overview: A drummer drums and keeps on drumming but slowly loses his sanity in the span of a couple minutes.

results.title: Piojo
results.overview: In the near future, a father must confront his spirituality when the authorities use a new technology to take his son from him.

results.title: Hitchhiker
results.overview: A woman traveling alone on a highway at night crosses paths with two men that change her life, one a lonely gas station attendant, and the other, a man on the run.

results.title: Anaimia
results.overview: A pregnant woman selling her home is haunted by bizarre cravings. After a night of binge eating, the Seller must hide herself, and a half eaten bag of mulch, as a Realtor takes a terminally ill Buyer on a tour of The House.

results.title: The Stars Are Comforting
results.overview: New Zealand astronomer Beatrice Tinsley sets off to Austin, Texas to get her theory of the universe heard.

results.title: Remy
results.overview: For more than twenty years, Remy has investigated cases for New York City’s Department of Homeless Services while quietly pursuing the dream that never left him: becoming an impressionist painter.

results.title: Like Riding a Cloud
results.overview: Success in the mountains is never a solitary pursuit, but what makes the collective effort worthwhile? Elevated by each other’s experience, four athletes reflect alongside sports performance psychologist Dr. John Coleman on group flow — a sensation of limitless possibility that isn’t confined to the individual, but shared through connectivity.

results.title: His Daughter
results.overview: Based on the life of Susan Atkins, who was forced to step into the role of a parent for her younger brother while her own home was broken by her parents' alcoholism and the death of her mother, this is how the constant struggle and the lack of a support system led her to trade one form of survival for a much darker, more destructive life that became her permanent reality.

results.title: Blood Money
results.overview: After their train robbery turns bloody at the hands of Texas Rangers, the survivors of one of America's last outlaw gangs rendezvous at their safehouse where they investigate who, if anyone, sold them out to the law.

results.title: Pride of Scotland
results.overview: In the heart of Edinburgh, a renowned Kilt manufacturer works to preserve a centuries-old Scottish tradition while training the next generation to carry it forward.

results.title: Live through this
results.overview: Jane Remover offers a candid look into the realities of touring as a musician. This documentary follows the behind-the-scenes moments, travel experiences, and performances that define life on the road, balancing the pressures of fame with the artistic dedication required for live shows.

results.title: I Made a Film in Excel
results.original_title: I Made a Film in Excel
results.overview: A short animated film with visuals done fully in Microsoft Excel.

results.title: Películas
results.overview: Lisandro, a young filmmaker, lies in bed with Nahuel, his lover. Lisandro is unable to get his films screened due to their subject matter, and a conversation with Nahuel leads him to make a decision.

results.title: Obsession Obsession
results.overview: Everyone loves Obsession. Except Eddie. When his friends Brad and Callum find out, Brad takes this into his own hands...

results.title: Calexico
results.overview: Ash, a 28-year-old Chinese American and rebellious aspiring artist, escapes her family's expectations. He travels to Calexico, a border town in California, where he forms a close bond with Lo, a Mexican student who crosses the border to deliver flowers to his uncle's florist in the United States. Both are stuck in limbo – living castaways in a foreign country, facing social pressures, family expectations, and questions about identity. During the last day together, they are forced to define their relationship.
